assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and atherosclerotic heart disease.
The patient has paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease.
The diagnosis codes are I48.0, I25.10, and I48.91.
The CPT code for the mobile cardiac telemetry is 93229.
The service is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate control management.
The payer denied CPT 93229 under Reason Code CO-197.
The denial is contested because the service directly addresses the patient's documented paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and symptomatic presentation.
